notes:
ThunderAlley 3.13.2: fixes and spawn protection
- Buttons now work on the first tap everywhere. Settings toggles, choices and list buttons were firing twice per tap, so toggles flipped straight back.
- Custom loadout: killstreaks pick with one tap. With 3 already chosen, tapping a new one swaps out the oldest.
- Bomb Defuse: a pulsing PLANT / DEFUSE button and a "HOLD TO PLANT/DEFUSE" prompt when you're at a site or the bomb, with a bigger range.
- Spawn protection replaces the safe zones: for 2 seconds after you spawn you can't be shot and can't hurt anyone. A countdown shows on screen.
- Domination: A, B and C are spread across the map in a wide triangle, so you have to run between them.
- Select Mode: the LARGE SCALE tab works again (Conquest, XL Conquest, Tank Transport, Rush).
- No more false "closed unexpectedly / safe graphics" message after updating, in the browser, or after swiping the game closed.
- After an update, the "Update installed" CONTINUE button works when you're signed in.
